meta.conceptLabel: 日曜日の記憶をたどる詩的ヒーリング
meta.tempoPolicy: 64-70 BPM only. Never increase BPM to shorten duration.
meta.genrePolicy: Quiet 1970s Japanese New Music, soft Kayokyoku and acoustic Folk. Soul/loungy colors only as restrained secondary texture.
meta.lyricPolicy: Metaphor-led poetic Japanese. No family-role labels, no direct emotional explanation, no moral conclusion. One central concrete metaphor per song; emotion is carried by light, shadow, temperature, reflection, distance, paper, glass, metal, cloth, road, or small sounds.
meta.healingPolicy: Mature low-mid chest vocals, soft attack, restrained dynamics, no belting, falsetto climax, octave jump, shouted ad-libs, busy call-and-response or hard snare.
meta.durationPolicy: 44-48 effective bars. Three compact sung scenes, one compact refrain, one 4-bar instrumental break. No long coda, no repeated outro, no extra final refrain.
meta.revisionNoteKo: 003을 일본 시니어 채널용으로 전면 재작성했다. 설명형 관계 가사를 폐기하고 구체적 사물 하나를 중심 은유로 삼았으며, 기존 잔잔한 버전보다 20~30초 짧게 생성되도록 4마디 간주와 압축된 3절 구조를 사용한다.
